verdict.rationale: The products page claims "status dashboards" for running multiple cases in parallel. That claim sits in the employer/People Ops pitch, though, and the only individual-facing item is "a simple checklist from start to approval" alongside dedicated support. So a founder-facing case-status view is implied at best, not documented. Missing for 10: any documentation of a client portal or dashboard for individual applicants, a description of the case-status and next-steps views, screenshots or a walkthrough, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the dashboard exists.
